diagnosis: The Kafka broker's memory limit was cut to 128Mi, but it runs with `KAFKA_HEAP_OPTS=-Xmx400M -Xms400M`. The JVM needs far more than the limit, so the broker is OOMKilled on every start and crash-loops. Accounting and fraud-detection receive nothing. Checkout's Kafka producer also gets stuck when the broker disappears, so orders start timing out, and it has to be restarted after the broker is fixed.
